classification_rule: Every case in this file must classify as Unknown. Preserved or Violated is an incorrect result because the frozen contract deliberately lacks authoritative evidence for the observation.

opaque_observation.subject: An array item representation containing non-ASCII scalar values placed at a candidate line-breaking boundary.

cases.why_opaque: The contract freezes the threshold only for measured ASCII bodies and explicitly leaves the non-ASCII counting unit unknown.

opaque_observation.subject: The repr of a math library member absent from every exact MathOp and non-MathOp case in the contract.

cases.why_opaque: The contract explicitly refuses to generalize membership or variant identity from neighboring math names.

opaque_observation.subject: A user MathOp whose content variant is not string, plain content, measured markup, or either measured escaping form.

cases.why_opaque: Unenumerated content morphologies are named Unknown and cannot inherit preservation from the measured content forms.

opaque_observation.subject: A syntactically or semantically opaque construction that the contract runner cannot parse into the frozen observable fragment.

cases.why_opaque: Parser-unsupported or opaque constructions are an explicit Unknown class; absence of an output is not evidence of preservation.

opaque_observation.subject: A claim of functional equivalence unrelated to the exact public repr morphology of arrays, tuples, or Content::MathOp.

cases.why_opaque: The frozen contract denies equivalence claims beyond its exact repr fragment.

opaque_observation.subject: Curly quote glyphs received as Content::Text after an earlier markup phase, where the same received glyphs may originate from SmartQuote syntax or from literal curved text.

cases.why_opaque: This owner observes only the already-resolved text glyphs and cannot legitimately reconstruct SmartQuote provenance by glyph recognition, textual heuristic or nominal specialization.
